batch.description: Transcribed 2026-10-31 from the compiler-solved CamScanner scan of the JU D Unit 2014-2015 paper in the AdmissionWar/Google Drive PDF ju-d-2014-2015-set3.pdf (6 pp.). ⚠ LISTING-VS-PRINTED SET DISCREPANCY: the Drive listing calls this file 'Set-3', but the printed header box on p.1 reads 'SET CODE: 5/6' — a merged pair code (Satt Academy's banks for this session are likewise merged pairs). The printed code governs, so the paper id is ju-d-2014-2015-set5-6. The compilation prints each question with a ব্যাখ্যা and a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key (X = Bangla option letter ক/খ/গ/ঘ); options are labelled (ক)-(ঘ), or (a)-(d) for English-language questions, whose keys are still given in Bangla letters. No answer table. Printed header: session ২০১৪-২০১৫, D-ইউনিট (জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ), 60 minutes, full marks 80, negative marking 0.20. The compilation prints no subject section headings; subjects were assigned per question by content, preserving printed order and numbering throughout: Bangla Q1-4; English Q9, Q13-16; General Mathematics Q5, Q6, Q8, Q11, Q12; IQ Q10; Biology Botany Q7 and Q17-36; Biology Zoology Q37-56; Chemistry Q57-80. Four key boxes (Q9, Q14, Q15, Q42) sit at the scan edge and their key letters are cropped/illegible — those questions are recorded keyless, not guessed. Transcribed visually from 300 dpi renders read as quadrant/tiles and zoom crops; render integrity verified by SHA-256 of the page renders (p.1: a86e7150c57ee6fe34569868887df128430fcbe662166abb6030f2e028bb7064) and crop-vs-full-page cross-checks. [UNVERIFIED import-format edition: only the questions that did NOT pass cross-source verification, with true statuses preserved; see Admission-Unverified-Import/README.md.]

sourceDocuments.title: JU D Unit 2014-2015 question paper, Set Code 5/6 — compiler-solved scan (AdmissionWar / Google Drive PDF)
sourceDocuments.notes: CamScanner scan of a compiler-solved reprint (per-question ব্যাখ্যা with a boxed 'উত্তরঃ X' key after most questions). The Drive listing label for this file is 'Set-3', but the printed header box reads 'SET CODE: 5/6'; the printed code governs. Aggregator footer 'For More Question Bank Visit www.admissionwar.com'; diagonal 'Admission War' watermarks and a Bengali advertising watermark are the aggregator's, not part of the question paper. Handwritten/reader marks are not keys. Two-column layout, options labelled (ক)-(ঘ) / (a)-(d). Downloaded from the AdmissionWar Google Drive archive for the admission-research project.

examRules.sourceNote: Printed header (PDF p.1): ১ম বর্ষ স্নাতক সম্মান ভর্তি পরীক্ষা ২০১৪-২০১৫; D-ইউনিট, জীববিজ্ঞান অনুষদ, জাহাঙ্গীরনগর বিশ্ববিদ্যালয়; boxed 'SET CODE: 5/6'; সময়ঃ ৬০ মিনিট, পূর্ণমানঃ ৮০. Printed instructions: (প্রতিটি ভুল উত্তরের জন্য ০.২০ নম্বর কাটা যাবে। প্রশ্নপত্রে উত্তর চিহ্নিত করা যাবে না) পরীক্ষার শুরুতে OMR শিটের নির্ধারিত স্থানে নিচের দু'টি বাক্য লিখতে হবে। ১। বদ্ধ পানি ডেঙ্গুবাহক মশার জন্মস্থান ২। 'Aedes mosquito is a vector for dengue virus' — the English sentence is printed with the misspellings 'Aedes' (for Aedes) and 'vector' (for vector), preserved here as printed.
